        <bibo:uri>http://dx.doi.org/10.1080/01639374.2012.682254</bibo:uri>
        <dcterms:abstract>The library catalog as a catalog of works was an infectious idea, which together with research led to reconceptualization in the form of the FRBR conceptual model. Two categories of lacunae emerge--the expression entity, and gaps in the model such as aggregates and dynamic documents.
